The equation factors as
\[
(a-b)(b-c)(a-c)=0,
\]
so at least two of \(a,b,c\) must be equal.

Total ordered triples: \(100^3=1{,}000{,}000\).

Triples with all distinct: \(100\cdot 99\cdot 98=970{,}200\).

Thus the desired count is
\[
1{,}000{,}000-970{,}200=29{,}800.
\]

\[
\boxed{29800}
\]
